summary: Build GDPR Foundation knowledge in privacy principles and compliance frameworks, and prepare for the PECB exam in this two-day course.
audienceIntro: GDPR Foundation training is intended for people who work with personal-data protection or information security, and for those building a foundation for a data-protection career.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the PECB Certificate Holder in GDPR Foundation credential, you must pass the PECB GDPR Foundation exam and sign the PECB Code of Ethics; professional experience and project experience are not required.
